title: Unsecured Business Loan Leads for UK Brokers | Loanleaf
description: Exclusive unsecured business loan leads from UK limited companies and LLPs. Priced £20 to £300 by fundability, one broker per lead, delivered in real time.
h1: Unsecured business loan leads for UK brokers and lenders
summary: Loanleaf unsecured business loan leads are exclusive enquiries from UK limited companies and LLPs that asked for business finance on the Loanleaf website. Each lead is sold to one broker only and priced from £20 to £300 in credits by how fundable it looks. Because the form does not ask about assets or property, the enquiries suit lenders who do not need security.

sections.h2: What Loanleaf offers unsecured lending brokers
blocks: An unsecured business loan is attractive to owners because nothing has to be pledged to get it. That also makes it a popular product to sell, and a competitive one. The brokers and lenders who do well with it are usually the ones who reach a business owner quickly, with the right information in front of them.

Loanleaf is an introducer. Business owners find us through search, our own content and paid online advertising, including Meta, and complete an enquiry form on our website. We do not buy in data, scrape lists or pass on cold contacts. Every lead is someone who asked for finance, in their own words, on the day they enquire.

This page explains how to find unsecured business loan leads within the Loanleaf feed, how pricing and auto-buy work, and what you will need to confirm on the call. It is open about what the form does not ask, so you can decide whether our leads suit your process.

sections.h2: Where the leads come from and who qualifies
blocks: Every enquiry is filtered on the form before it is submitted. Businesses that do not meet the basics are turned away at that point, so they never reach the platform and you never pay for them.

list: UK limited companies and LLPs only. Sole traders, ordinary partnerships and businesses not yet trading are turned away.
At least 6 months trading and annual revenue of £50,000 or more.
A loan amount chosen from £5,000 to £2m+.
A valid UK mobile number and an email domain that can receive email, both checked on the form.
No paying twice: a repeat enquiry within 7 days goes back to the broker who bought it at no extra cost, and after that you never receive the same lead again.

blocks: Before submitting, the business owner ticks one box confirming they agree to our terms and privacy policy, understand that Loanleaf is an introducer, not a lender or broker, and understand their details will be shared with a broker we match them with, who may contact them by phone, email or text about business finance. The exact wording and the time they agreed are recorded and sent with the lead.

sections.h2: Why the Loanleaf form suits unsecured lending
blocks: The form asks about the business and the borrowing, not about what the owner could offer as security. It does not ask about property value, loan to value, property addresses or other assets. For a lender or broker who works without security, that is not a gap. It means the enquiry is not already framed around a secured product.

That said, nothing on the lead says the owner wants an unsecured loan, or would refuse a secured one. Some will simply have asked for a figure. You find out what suits them on the call, and the same enquiry may be right for one of your products and wrong for another.
If you also arrange lending against property or assets, our page on commercial finance leads shows how the feed supports other products.

sections.h2: Reading an unsecured lead and the signals that matter
blocks: Every lead carries a set of answers you can read before you buy. For unsecured lending, brokers tend to give most weight to the following.

list: Loan amount. Owners choose from £5,000 to £2m+. Lenders without security usually work within a band, so the amount is often the first filter.
Revenue band and time trading. Revenue runs from £50k to £100k up to £5m+, and time trading from 6 to 12 months up to 5+ years. Together they show how much track record the business has.
Credit history. Each lead says whether there have been missed payments, defaults or CCJs in the last 6 years: No, Yes or Not sure.
Existing finance. The lead shows whether the business already borrows, with bands for the amount left to repay and the monthly repayments.

Purpose and timeline. Purposes include Growth and expansion, Cash flow, Equipment or vehicles, Stock and inventory, Refinance existing debt, Tax or VAT bill and Something else. Timelines run from As soon as possible to Just exploring options.

blocks: The quality score, from 0 to 100, brings credit history, time trading, revenue, urgency and existing debt into a single figure. Treat it as a guide to sorting, not a promise of outcome.

sections.h2: The honest limits of an unsecured lead
blocks: The form does not ask about card takings, sector, director names or bank statements. It does not ask about property or assets either. If your lenders need any of those, you gather them on the first call.

The form also cannot tell you how a lender will view a particular business. Some enquiries will not meet a lender's appetite for credit history, existing debt or the size of the ask relative to revenue. Loanleaf sells qualified enquiries, not guaranteed deals, and a lead stays valid even if the business later chooses another provider or is declined.
A realistic view of conversion is part of buying well. Set your criteria tightly, track what funds in the pipeline and adjust.

sections.h2: Setting up auto-buy for unsecured business loan leads
blocks: Loanleaf Platform lets you buy one lead at a time or switch on auto-buy, which purchases matching leads the moment they arrive. If several brokers match, a fair rotation decides who gets the lead. Each lead is sold to one broker only.
A starting setup for unsecured lending might include:

list: Loan size range: the amounts your lenders will do without security.
Revenue bands and time trading: the minimums your panel works to.
Purposes: the ones you place most often, such as Growth and expansion, Cash flow or Equipment or vehicles.
Clean credit only: on if your lenders decline adverse history, off if they do not.
Limits: leads per day, credits per day, credits per month and a maximum credits per lead.

blocks: Leads that match but cost more than your per-lead maximum are left for manual buying and you get an email alert. If you prefer manual mode, you can still get an email when a matching lead arrives. Our auto-buy page covers each setting in more detail.

sections.h2: What unsecured business loan leads cost
blocks: One credit is worth £1. Each lead costs between £20 and £300, set by a scoring model that looks at loan size, revenue, time trading, credit history and affordability. Affordability means whether the amount asked for is realistic for the business's revenue. You see the price before you buy.

A sensible request from an established business costs more, while a long shot costs the minimum. A £100k request from a business with £250k to £500k revenue and 2 to 5 years trading is 95 credits. A £5m ask from a 6 to 12 month old business with £100k to £250k revenue is 15.

Monthly plans exclude VAT: Starter is £2,500 for 2,500 credits, Growth is £5,000 for 5,000 credits, and Custom starts from £6,000 in £1,000 steps. Unused credits roll over while you are subscribed, and you can cancel at any time. Prices can change without notice, so set a maximum price per lead. The pricing page has the detail.

sections.h2: What you see before you buy and what you get after
blocks: Before buying you see a summary of each live lead with the amount, purpose, timeline, revenue, time trading, credit history, existing finance and quality score. Contact details are masked, for example a***@b****.co.uk and +447*******90, with checks for a valid UK mobile and a verified email domain.

On purchase, the business name and full contact details unlock. The lead is delivered instantly on the platform, by email and to your CRM by webhook (JSON). That works with Zapier, Make, HubSpot, Pipedrive and any CRM that accepts webhooks. The platform has a simple pipeline with New, Contacted, Application, Funded and Lost stages, notes and CSV export.
If the phone number is not in service or belongs to someone else, or the email address does not exist, you can ask for a refund within 72 hours of purchase. There are no refunds for other reasons.

sections.h2: Working an unsecured lead on the first call
blocks: Because you can read the lead before dialling, the first call can begin with the business, not an introduction. Many brokers use it to confirm and add to what the form already shows.

list: Confirm the amount, purpose and timeline, and ask what is driving them.
Ask about existing borrowing and repayments, checking against the finance bands on the lead.
Ask how the business takes payment and whether bank statements can be shared.
Ask about sector, directors and trading address, which the form does not collect.
Talk through what a lender will want to see, and what happens next.

blocks: If an unsecured product is not the right fit, you may be able to help another way. Our pages on business loan leads and asset finance leads show how the same feed supports other products.

faqs.q: Are these leads only for unsecured loans?
faqs.a: No. They are pre-screened for commercial lending in general. The form does not ask about property or assets, so nothing on the lead says whether the owner wants a secured or unsecured product. You find that out on the first call.

faqs.q: How do I find leads that suit an unsecured lender?
faqs.a: Set your criteria in auto-buy: loan size range, revenue bands, time trading, purposes and whether to include adverse credit. Matching leads are bought for you as they arrive. In manual mode, read the lead summary and quality score before you buy.

faqs.q: How much do these leads cost?
faqs.a: Each lead costs between £20 and £300 in credits, where one credit is £1. The price reflects loan size, revenue, time trading, credit history and affordability, and you see it before you buy.

faqs.q: Can I exclude leads with adverse credit?
faqs.a: Yes. Each lead shows whether there have been missed payments, defaults or CCJs in the last 6 years. You can switch on clean credit only in auto-buy, or choose to include them if your lenders accept them.
Yes. Each lead is sold to one broker only. Once bought, it disappears for everyone else and is never resold.

faqs.q: Will every lead turn into a funded loan?
faqs.a: No. Not every enquiry converts. Some businesses compare options, some do not meet a lender's criteria and some decide not to borrow. Loanleaf provides qualified enquiries, not guaranteed deals.

faqs.q: What happens if the contact details are wrong?
faqs.a: You can ask for a refund within 72 hours of purchase if the phone number is not in service or belongs to someone else, or the email address does not exist. Refunds are not given for any other reason.

faqs.q: Do I need to take a minimum number of leads?
faqs.a: No. You subscribe to a monthly plan from £2,500 a month excluding VAT and spend your credits on the leads you want. You can cancel at any time.
